assets.label: 近代市政大厅
assets.assetType: World-122 near-modern industrial-era municipal town hall
assets.foundationRoutingNote: The approved fieldstone model uses the generator equivalent rubble_stone; geometry remains unchanged.
assets.primaryRequest: Render the supplied near-modern municipal hall. Keep TWO occupied storeys and ONE compact clock housing with two clock faces at the SAME height, capped by ONE small pyramidal copper roof. Preserve the full-width FLAT second-floor balcony with open iron rails along its front and both sides, central glazed balcony doors, small civic medallion on the front rail, four ground-floor arcade arches and the central public entrance. Each upper front wing has one arched window and one outer muted-green banner; the visible side has FOUR glazed upper windows and FOUR lower windows. Keep the complete low stone base and steps. The continuous main roof is standing-seam gray-green copper, not roof tiles; metal window frames and two rainwater downpipes remain attached.
assets.paletteConstraint: warm gray masonry, pale dressed-stone trim, dull gray-green copper roofs, dark green-gray metal frames, subdued blue-green glazing, dark iron rails, small aged-brass civic details
assets.negativeRequest: No extra storey, stacked clock housing, third clock, added side-wall banner, missing balcony door, balcony canopy, solar panels, machinery, factory chimney, vehicles, large gold ornament or readable lettering.
